description: Orchestrated delivery of checksum-bound public crop-spectrum and meteorological forecast evaluation artifacts
activation_gate: The accepted GHISACONUS receipt and frozen forecast export must re-verify before any model execution. The crop and forecast lanes are independently gated and neither may create a publication, strategy, or causal-efficacy result.
delivery_boundary: A historical crop-spectrum benchmark and a seven-day regional meteorological backtest are the only planned artifacts. Water, energy, vegetation, soil, yield/cost, biodiversity, scenario, property, and strategy goals require their own future retained target contract.
